data.longBusinessSummary: The fund seeks to meet its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, in any one of, or combinations of, Financial Instruments (including swap agreements, futures contracts, forward contracts and option contracts) based on the benchmark. The types and mix of Financial Instruments in which the fund invests may vary daily at the discretion of the Sponsor. It will not invest directly in any commodity.

content.title: Silver Shines Brighter Than Gold: ETFs in Focus
content.summary: Silver hovers around $40, marking its strongest level since 2011 (per tradingeconomics), with ETFs like SLV up about 37% this year, outpacing gold-backed GLD.
